: Provenance: HAND-AUTHORED under SMA-316 (PR #30), not captured from the
: wire. SMA-522 (PR #197) changed it. The SMA-522 design says that a keyless
: LiteLLM mock cannot emit streamed tool calls, because `mock_tool_calls` is
: ignored on the proxy streaming path (Appendix A.3).
:
: The source of the tool-call delta shape (two calls interleaved by `index`,
: with the arguments split over several deltas) is not recorded. The SMA-316
: plan calls the file hand-authored.
:
: What follows the capture, and what does not. The finish chunk, the
: separate trailing usage chunk and `[DONE]` follow the LiteLLM capture in
: chat_text_usage_trailing.txt. The envelope does not follow it. The usage
: chunk here has the keys `id`, `object`, `created`, `model`; the capture has
: `id`, `created`, `model`, `object`. This file has no
: `completion_tokens_details`. The values `id` "x", `created` 1700000000 and
: model "gpt-4o" are not from a capture. The usage chunk keeps the proxy
: form `"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{}}]`, not `"choices":[]`.
:
: History. SMA-316 (PR #30) wrote this file with `usage` on the finish
: chunk. SMA-522 (PR #197) moved `usage` to its own trailing chunk.
